seated_mating_estimates.equation: Host mouth X = insertion - 27.051; shoulder-to-host gap = 21.0058 - insertion; bend-axis projection from host = 27.051 - insertion

unknown_valve_or_check_socket.status: Best layout estimate for unmeasured VK/check receiving sockets, not a supplier specification

interactions: The inserted male stem occupies the host's female tube corridor; that intentional overlap is not a body collision
A positive shoulder gap is expected when the male tip bottoms before the shoulder meets the host collet
Replacement of a union elbow removes that elbow's receiving socket and tube link; it does not add this stem elbow after the union elbow
The release collet remains a moving part; the displayed gap is a seating estimate, not a release-tool qualification
